scope: Full mathematical and literal endpoint review of ASG1-ASG10: actual UnitaryGroupInstance, full UnitaryLatticeData/FixedHyp under the original Forms0 premise, and generic ScPsiExists. ASG11-ASG18 and the remaining HidaSetting blocks have separate reviewers. No full HidaSetting or GroupCompatibilityFamily construction is inferred here. findings: ASG1: the coordinate pullback preserves the actual field, Hermitian form, original lattice and unimodularity. The rank equality and Boolean sign count give exactly (k+s,s+1), with the original embedding-place bijection and prescribed sign order. Restricted-product congruence neighbourhoods supply both AutInst topology fields; the inherited FV4 comparison retains the same group.

ASG2: the literal cmUnram residue condition excludes ramified quadratic places, including residue characteristic two. Local trace surjectivity then makes the global integral trace ideal the unit ideal. The prescribed aaD are nonzero conjugation-invariant negative powers of the actual different, and the original g_split cardinality forces all ramification and residue degrees to one at both host primes.

ASG3: the Hilbert class field is Galois over the maximal real subfield because its defining maximal unramified abelian property is conjugation invariant. Chebotarev at the ideal-class inverse gives a split prime, with a choice of prolongation giving the precise required Artin element; residue degree one prevents an unintended Frobenius power. Finite avoidance, conjugate coprimality and principalization all occur in the original CM field.

ASG4: w lies in p and has trace one; the conjugation in b=conj(-Tw/alpha) gives norm -T. Unimodularity makes b f integral. Pairing a scalar multiple with f and alpha e, and using aT+p0=1, proves actual global primitiveness for every nonzero natural T. The argument requires no principal ideal class for the starting hyperbolic plane.

ASG5: the retained actual Forms0.val0.de matrix gives a norm-one vector in X(0), and its actual atT.piU rescales the norm to T(u0). The D7.sp_T and orthogonality fields then give a nonzero extra isotropic direction, in the original ambient space, orthogonal to all existing hyperbolic vectors.

ASG6: the intersection with the totally isotropic E-space is saturated and of the full required rank. Its projective Dedekind-module structure and Steinitz determinant class permit the prescribed first s ideal factors and one final fractional ideal. Extending the module isomorphism to E gives actual embedded equality, also when s=0.

ASG7: the splitting retraction provides the required coefficient functionals. The triangular correction has B+C+C*=0. The integrality calculation uses h(e_i,y) in conjugate(c_i)^(-1) and h(e_i,y) B_ji in c_j, so it remains valid for a final ideal which is not conjugation invariant. No division by two or freeness assumption is introduced.

ASG8: the actual orthogonal projection has integral coefficients in a_i and a_i^(-1), giving the stated lattice equality. The reserved last hyperbolic pair produces all primitive negative vectors while keeping the same first s pairs, common lattice and prescribed ideals for every original word.

ASG9: the local generators may be chosen as global members of each fractional ideal, and may be one at the distinguished primes because these are negative powers of an integral ideal with unit localization. The direct hyperbolic projection proves the stronger primitiveness in the source Lsub. All IsLift, IsFixedConv, Fu_e, flagZVector and Lam_split fields match literally.

ASG10: the negative finite principal-parts sign and positive infinite exponential give the rational product identity. The adelic trace kills the actual integral tensor algebra, and the chosen embeddings exhaust CM pairs once, so no missing factor of two occurs. The construction proves the full generic ScPsiExists target for arbitrary original AutInst.
